name: keepr
description: Read, add and change the records you keep in keepr, from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to your keepr account through its API. Read your collections, add records from a sentence, a list or a spreadsheet, and propose changes to cards — each write is dry-run first and shown to you before anything is committed. Paste an API key from keepr (My Profile → API keys); it is stored by Claude, never in a file.

api_key.title: keepr API key
api_key.description: Create one in keepr under My Profile → API keys. Read-only keys can only read; tick Can write and Can change cards for the rest.

tools.name: keepr_collections
tools.description: Who this API key acts as, its scopes (read, write, cards, delete), and every keepr collection it can reach, with the access level, whether writing is possible in each, and whether cards can be changed.

tools.name: keepr_schema
tools.description: What a keepr collection accepts: its cards (record types), every element (field) on each, the data type each element wants, and which elements are written by the server and must never be sent.

tools.name: keepr_get_items
tools.description: Read records from a keepr collection: list them, filter with KQL, count them, or fetch specific items by id.

tools.name: keepr_search
tools.description: Find something by text across every keepr collection this key can reach — collections, card types, and items.

tools.name: keepr_ingest
tools.description: Write records into a keepr collection.

tools.name: keepr_update_item
tools.description: Change specific elements on ONE existing keepr item, addressed by its id.

tools.name: keepr_propose_card
tools.description: Work out what a new card (record type) would look like, or what a change to an existing card would do, WITHOUT changing anything.

tools.name: keepr_apply_card
tools.description: Actually create or change the card(s) from a keepr_propose_card proposal.

tools.name: keepr_attach_file
tools.description: Attach files to a keepr item.
